body:
The Strategy Tasks tab should show when each task was created. Tasks don't record this today: a task has `closedTime` and `archivedTime` (D-87), but `board.rs::new_task` sets no creation time.

**Server (root project)**
- `board.rs::new_task` sets `createdTime` (seconds, like `closedTime`). It is set once and never changes, including on restore, a move between projects or an edit.
- Older tasks get it when they load, in the same place as the D-87 back-fill in `board.rs`. Use the earliest of: the first note's time, the first run's start, or else the file's modified time.
- `strategy.rs` passes `createdTime` along with `closedTime` in a task's brief. `specs/15-board-api.md` lists the field.
- This is a new field on the task record, so it needs a short DECISIONS.md entry.

**Strategy page**
- The Tasks tab gets a **Created** column, shown as a date in the same format as the closed column.
- The default sort stays as it is (closed tasks newest first, then open ones by title). Sorting by any column is the next task.
- Update the Tasks tab section of the strategy README.

**Tests:** `tasks.rs`/`board_tests.rs`:
- a new task gets `createdTime`;
- an old task takes its first note's time, else its first run's start, else the file's time;
- a move or restore keeps it.

Strategy view test: the Created cell renders. `board_acceptance.py`: a created task has an integer `createdTime`.
title: tasks: created time column
